735c8b8b379e.title: Computer Vision/Machine Learning Intern, 2027
735c8b8b379e.description_html:
Company Overview
ACS (Allen Control Systems) is a defense technology company building precision robotic systems for the United States and its allies. Founded by two former U.S. Navy electrical engineers with deep experience in robotics and software, ACS brings together AI, computer vision, precision motion, and advanced hardware to solve complex defense challenges across land, air, and maritime environments.

Our flagship product, Bullfrog, is an autonomous precision weapon system that transforms existing weapons into highly accurate counter-drone systems — giving warfighters a scalable, cost-effective response to one of the fastest-growing threats on the modern battlefield. Bullfrog is deployed with U.S. forces, and ACS works with organizations throughout the U.S. military and national security community.

Following a $200 million Series B at a $2.2 billion valuation, ACS is rapidly expanding manufacturing, accelerating Bullfrog deployments, and developing the next generation of autonomous battlefield systems. This is an opportunity to join a proven, fast-moving team and help scale technology with direct, real-world impact on national security.

ACS is headquartered in Austin, Texas, with additional operations in Alexandria, Virginia; Mountain View, California; and Huntsville, Alabama. For more information, visit allencontrolsystems.com.

Our interns aren't fetching coffee or shadowing — they're working alongside the same engineers building the systems we ship. This is early-career work with real stakes.

Location: Austin, TX (on-site)

Duration: Summer 2027 (~10-12 wks)

Pay: Paid internship

Team: Small, hands-on, direct impact

What You Could Work On:

  • Models that detect, track, and classify drones and other aerial threats in real time

  • Training data generation and pipeline work — the unglamorous but critical foundation of any good model

  • Getting models to run fast on real embedded hardware (like NVIDIA Jetson), not just in a notebook

  • Experiments in sensor fusion, tracking robustness, and performance under real-world field conditions

(We're keeping this general on purpose — exact projects depend on where things stand next summer, but this is the flavor of work you'd be doing.)

What We're Looking For:

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field

  • Coursework or project experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, or similar

  • Comfortable in Python, with some exposure to C++ a plus

  • Genuine interest in real-time perception — models that have to work in milliseconds, not just on a benchmark

Why ACS:

  • Direct impact: your work ships on hardware being fielded to protect real people — not stuck in a slide deck.

  • Real ownership: no red tape. You'll work directly with the engineers building Bullfrog, from day one.

  • Small team, big scope: at a startup this size, interns take on real problems, not busywork.

  • Mentorship from engineers who've designed and fielded real defense systems.

Allen Control Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Allen Control Systems prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

A. Morton Thomas and Associates, Inc. (AMT) is seeking a highly motivated and diverse Transportation Engineer Intern (STEM - Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) to join us in our Herndon, VA office for the 2027 internship period. This is a paid full-time position with anticipated duration from May through August 2027 (flexible) and has the potential to transition into a Full-Time Junior Engineer Role upon graduation. The successful candidate will work under the supervision of Project Managers and Team Leaders with partnerships with other engineering staff.    As an active, socially responsible, and tight-knit community, we are looking for top talent to join us in our Herndon, VA office.

Responsibilities

Support various project tasks including regulatory requirements/reviews, cost estimates, research, procurement support, etc.; Perform data entry, management, evaluation, and presentation; Support the preparation of reports, plans, and specifications for clients; May work on field assignments as needed; Will be supported by leaders, mentors, and teammates; and Perform other related duties and responsibilities as necessary

Minimum Requirements

Must be at least 18 years old; Pursuing Bachelor or Associates Degree in Civil/Transportation Engineering or related field; Minimum GPA of 3.0; Has excellent verbal and written communication skills; Possesses solid technical and problem-solving skills; Self-motivated, detail oriented person; Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Power Point); and Honest, fun, hard-working and ready to learn and grow.   Preferred Qualifications Experience with engineering software applications (AutoCAD, MathCAD, Bentley Microstation, etc.) is preferred but not required. Don’t know a lot about finance or trading? No sweat. Belvedere Trading University (BTU) program will teach you everything you need to know once you join the team.

  • Communicate with project managers and team leadership to develop work strategies

  • High performer – Experience developing efficient, user-friendly, extensible programs, preferably with an object-oriented programming language such as C++, C#, or Java   

  • Ownership – Thrive in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment 

  • Intellectual curiosity and passion – Desire to continuously learn in a team environment, solve challenging problems and learn quickly 

  • Strong Communication – Effectively communicate project updates to teammates and product managers 

  • AI Fluency – Effectively use AI tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness while maintaining independent judgement and critical thinking

  • Ability to live in Chicago and attend the internship fully in person during the summer of 2027  

  • Graduation date of December 2027/Spring 2028
